findings.title: Insecure Cookie Flag Configuration
findings.evidence: Set-Cookie attribute inspection: cookie-missing-secure: Cookie 'owasp-locale' missing Secure flag
findings.remediation: Set Secure, HttpOnly, and SameSite=Lax/Strict flags on all session cookies.
findings.exposure_context: Passive OSINT Discovery / Standard Web Ingress
findings.reachability_evidence: Finding relates to network/protocol configuration rather than application code.

backport_verdict.explanation: Standard upstream version string; no distribution backport packaging patterns detected.

techniques.mitigation: Audit public Certificate Transparency logs and decommission dangling DNS records for subdomains.
Enforce HTTP Strict Transport Security (HSTS) with `preload`, secure cookies (`Secure; HttpOnly; SameSite=Strict`), and modern TLS 1.3.

primary.mitigation: Audit public Certificate Transparency logs and decommission dangling DNS records for subdomains.

ssvc.rationale: No active exploit and minimal/internal network footprint.
